description: Free. Export a subsystem and its dependencies (types, interface and item definitions, requirements, allocations; anything else as reference proxies) into a package of a target. dry_run returns the diff (create, update, unchanged, delete candidate) and touches nothing; create refuses a package that already holds it; update writes in place through the id map and never duplicates.

model_id.description: A saved model id (m_ followed by 24 hex digits), as the studio and /v1/repos list them.

ref.description: A branch, commit or baseline (default main).

subsystem_id.description: Qualified name of a package or definition, e.g. "L4Robotaxi::NetworkSwitch".

target_package.description: Qualified name (Vehicle::Chassis::Braking) or a tool element id.

name: mbe_export
title: Export a subsystem
